technique: The attached image is our APPROVED ORIGINAL style reference only. Produce ONLY the requested standalone production asset, do not reproduce the grid, UI, any lettering or whole screenshot. Rugged adult American underground sci-fi comic, drawn with broad blunt brush pen and fat black marker. PURPOSEFUL asymmetry, variable heavy black contours, broad solid-black shadow wedges, flat opaque spot-ink colors, at most two colored tones plus black per form. Sparse visible dry-brush breaks on a FEW edges, NOT uniform grain or dense scratches. Graphic silhouette before interior details. Avoid glossy renders, soft cel mascot, airbrush, gradients, 3D, bright rim streaks, bloom, fake halftone, many tiny texture marks, pristine symmetry, watermark. NO text, letters, numbers, signatures or logos. Foreground inks olive-lime #779B32, olive shadow #3F5424, cream #F5E6BE, mustard #DDA831, brick red #C45240, near black #171C1A. Background inks cold light blue #C8DFE6, dusty lilac #9D8DB7, plum #57465E, muted salmon #D58983, cream #F5E6BE, charcoal #171C1A. Match the opinionated ink drawings of the approved reference, with large clear shapes.

assets.bg_base: Wide 16:9 BACKGROUND ONLY. Original crooked intergalactic fermentation lab in the approved image's rugged ink. Far left: two towering SALMON PINK pickle tanks containing just three BLACK cucumber silhouettes each, dented purple housings, thick bent pipes, odd bolted hatches, a small red diner stool and mustard bottle. Upper-left: black-space porthole with pale stars, UFO and large warped planet rings. Central 55% is quiet pale lilac wall behind the future board. Rightmost 26% is quiet bright COLD LIGHT BLUE wall, NO GREEN OR YELLOW THERE, no machinery, no ring behind future head, for a green character to stand in front. Floor broad lavender slabs with 3-4 crooked ink seams. Dense props left/top. Bold rough marker contours, flat inks, BLACK spot shadows in left machinery. No characters, board, frame, UI or text. Bright overall exposure, right area paper-light.
assets.mg: ONE FULL-BODY male anthropomorphic pickle diner boss. Green PICKLE is ENTIRE head and torso, no human skin. Re-create approved boss's tough asymmetrical expression: crooked small cream paper hat, heavy brows, dark pointed mustache, three big uneven teeth in lopsided grin, huge pickle belly, broad black shadow down flank, six big angular bumps. Red neckerchief, short dirty-cream waist apron, green calves with white socks and oversized mustard boots. TWO green arms naturally hang freely, elbows slightly bent, entire forearms and green three-finger hands separated from torso by >=6% canvas width. No hands resting on body, props or pockets. Feet planted, full cap-to-soles shown. Stands upright looking screen LEFT, at right of future board. Portrait 1:2 transparent canvas, figure fills 82% height, 8% padding all sides. Exaggerated rugged comic, NO shiny skin streaks, few ink scuffs, clear large shadow masses. Only this one figure; transparent background, no ground shadow.
assets.fg: ONE FULL-BODY FEMALE anthropomorphic spicy dill pickle chef, different person from male boss: tall wiry angular green cucumber torso, narrow pinched waist and long face, one raised jagged eyebrow, cocky toothy sideways grin, dark thick lashes, large tied BRICK RED BANDANA on crown with a loose ribbon, NO MUSTACHE, no paper hat. Dirty-cream wrap apron with brick-red trim, rolled green vegetable arms (no human skin), short green legs with tall cream socks and big brick-red work boots. A few angular cucumber bumps. TWO green arms naturally hang freely, elbows slightly bent, whole forearms and relaxed green three-finger hands separated from torso by >=6% canvas width. No hands on body, props or pockets. Feet planted, full cap-to-soles shown. Stands upright looking screen LEFT. Portrait 1:2 transparent canvas, 82% figure height and 8% padding all sides. Same black ink weight, rough flat fills and broad black spot shadows as approved boss. No shiny skin, no cute chibi, no erotic outfit. Only this one figure; transparent background, no ground shadow.

assets.frame: ONE square 1280x1280-style EMPTY reel housing/frame asset ONLY. Mustard-yellow dented spaceship order hatch from approved image, slightly crooked outer rectangle with variable FAT charcoal ink edges, four dark bolted corners, broad flat mustard rail and cream narrow inset lip. VERY LARGE EMPTY RECTANGULAR OPENING centered, true alpha transparency in opening, about 78% of width and 78% of height. Border about 7% frame width, beyond edge true transparency 3% margin. Inner opening is a tidy rectangle with rounded corners <=1%, nearly square. No background fill inside hole, no white paper inside opening, no cells, symbols, letters, numbers, UI, logo or title. Few purposeful large edge chips, not many little scuffs, no glass, metal gloss or 3D. Standalone coarse ink frame with genuine transparent outside AND center.
